Work in /home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research and read AGENTS.md. The user requests TEN substantial findings and expressly authorizes T3 subagents. Eight accepted, two remain. Accept ALL theorems AND lower proof operations in openai/math at fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb. Do not audit upstream truth or synthesize contradictions/ex-falso results. A routine corollary, standard algorithmic reduction, implementation with no new mechanism or conditional gap is not a substantial finding. No children, shared edits, staging, commits or publication. Parent integrates and reviews candidates independently.

This is FRESH DISCOVERY, not another review round. Read the four current ledgers to avoid duplicating previous work or splitting accepted findings. I111 independently passes the full original rational chromatic tail proof without repairs but confirms its technical disposition, so the count remains eight. I109 modular IMM rank constructions are parked after scoped exponential-loss obstructions; do not resume them. I110 studies Galois moment cancellation; I112 studies inverse boundary recovery. Do not bind their active outputs. Earlier matching entropy, common-base entropy and weighted graph-switch work are distinct but must be checked for overlap with your chosen proposal.

First screen 3–4 EXACT potentially substantial targets after reading actual source statements and lower constructions. Check all stronger relevant pinned companions and later versions early. Choose the strongest genuinely remaining target and develop at least TWO serious proof routes; do actual mathematics beyond a catalogue survey. Pay a new estimate/construction rather than restating a missing lemma. Try counterexamples and strongest known reductions. State exact hypotheses, quantifiers, category, parameter dependence, source dependencies and full proof for every positive claim. If unresolved, preserve the deepest paid bridge and precise gap without forced nomination. Numerical evidence is not proof. Distinguish author proof, independently audited theorem, technical consequence, conjecture, falsified proposal and evidence status.

Relate proposed progress to a real significant named problem/MathDB page if available. Cite observed significance evidence only; no invented ranking. Browse current primary literature for niche facts, full relevant proof operations and exact versions; don't substitute search snippets or titles. No worldwide-priority, human-review or formal-certification claim. A full-scope concrete reduction to accepted lower proof operations can defeat substantiality even absent an exact duplicate, but don't dismiss everything merely because classical tools are used.

Evidence: complete sources/preprints-tree.json has 13223 entries, 749 manuscripts and 10373 original blob positions; sources/tree.json is truncated. Freeze immutable originals and snapshots; ONLY README.md, frontier/README.md, frontier/TEN-FINDINGS.md and frontier/iterations/README.md may drift. Do not bind I110/I112 working outputs. Explore online optimization, prophet selection and exact stochastic game algorithms. Actual source-title leads (not theorem contracts): One-Sample-Suffices-for-Matroid-Prophet-Inequalities-against-an-Almighty-Adversary-September-23-2026; Squared-logarithmic-randomized-k-server-on-arbitrary-metrics-September-24-2026; Uniform-computation-of-the-squared-logarithmic-k-server-bound-September-24-2026; Deterministic-quasipolynomial-time-mean-payoff-games-September-25-2026; Turn-Based-Stochastic-Mean-Payoff-Games-in-Deterministic-Quasipolynomial-Time-October-5-2026; Mean-payoff-parity-games-in-quasipolynomial-time-October-5-2026. Read complete relevant operations and screen stronger companions early. You may reject these leads for a nearby genuinely viable target.

Seek a new implementable selection or comparison mechanism, an extension in actual adversary/feasibility scope, or exact strategy/value recovery beyond the source contract with the quantitative cost paid. For prophets, distinguish independence from correlation, prior knowledge from one sample, exact same-distribution samples from misspecified samples, welfare guarantees from high-probability guarantees, almighty seed-aware order from oblivious order, and oracle query/bit cost from existence of an exponential rule. Check information-theoretic and oracle lower bounds before proposing a polynomial implementation. For k-server, preserve one policy for every request sequence, additive movement constants, finite versus infinite metrics, support growth, per-request bit cost, and the actual oblivious adversary; adaptive adversaries can invalidate a direct transfer. For stochastic games, distinguish expectation-of-liminf, liminf-of-expectation, almost-sure objectives and threshold sets from exact values and policies; preserve binary probability/reward encoding, precision, unbounded memory and convergence budgets. Standard rational reconstruction, strategy enumeration or discount-limit reduction alone may be technical unless a genuinely unpaid quantitative bridge is established. Select 3–4 exact plausible targets then develop TWO serious routes for the strongest viable one. State a precise gap if unresolved; do not force a nomination.
